strings.web.about.embedded: This page and its assets are embedded in the slot binary; no external fonts, scripts or CDN resources are loaded.
strings.web.about.usageIp: If the device IP changes (after switching Wi-Fi, say), reopen the address it shows.
strings.web.about.usageRoms: The Games page replaces covers and ROMs and uploads a description (.txt) or a demo video (.mp4); its detail page exports one game, and the toolbar exports or imports a collection ZIP with ROMs, covers, descriptions and videos.
strings.web.about.usageSaves: The Saves page previews save-state thumbnails, downloads saves, replaces states and battery saves with an upload, and deletes local saves; deleting does not touch cloud sync or remote backups.
strings.web.about.usageSecurity: This service has no login; keep it on your home LAN and never expose it to the internet.

strings.web.about.usageWifi: The device and your phone or PC must share one Wi-Fi.
